chunks.title: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa, (1978) 2 SCC 213
chunks.content:
### Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa, (1978) 2 SCC 213
**Bench & Court:** 7-Judge Constitution Bench (Krishna Iyer, J.)
**Core Holding:** Established the comprehensive "Triple Test" to define "industry" under Section 2(j) IDA: systematic activity, cooperation between employer and employee, for production/distribution of goods and services.

chunks.title: State of Karnataka v. Umadevi (3), (2006) 4 SCC 1
chunks.content:
### State of Karnataka v. Umadevi (3), (2006) 4 SCC 1
**Bench & Court:** 5-Judge Constitution Bench
**Core Holding:** Held that public employment must adhere to Article 14 and 16; contractual or temporary employees cannot claim automatic regularization unless appointed against sanctioned posts through regular selection.

chunks.title: Domestic Enquiry & Natural Justice
chunks.content:
### Domestic Enquiry & Natural Justice
1. **Enquiry Procedure:** Strict compliance with principles of natural justice (specific charge sheet, right to cross-examine management witnesses, reasoned enquiry report).
2. **Labour Court Jurisdiction (Section 11A IDA):** Discretion of Labour Court to modify disproportionate punishment of dismissal.

chunks.title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 (IDA)
chunks.content:
### Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 (IDA)
- **Section 2(oo) & 25F:** Definition of retrenchment and conditions precedent for retrenchment (1 month notice and 15 days average pay per completed year of continuous service).
- **Section 33C(2):** Recovery of money or statutory benefits due from employer through Labour Court adjudication.

chunks.title: Code on Wages, 2019 & POSH Act, 2013
chunks.content:
### Code on Wages, 2019 & POSH Act, 2013
- Universal statutory entitlement to minimum wages, timely wage payment, and equal remuneration.
- Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Workplace (POSH Act) Section 4 & 11: Mandatory Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) and fair domestic enquiry.
